_readme: THE CREATIVE QC LOOP, every tool, every stage (the owner, 2026-10-02: 'i want this kind of creative QC process installed for each of my production tools … this should exist for all stages in the creation process'). Each entry says what the stage makes, what its output must agree with, its hard bars, and where a problem is fixed. quality_checks/review.py reads this; the reviewer prompt is prompts/creative-review-v1-damon.md. No brand is named here — every brand runs the same bars. A stage key may be a prefix (stage4 covers stage4b).

default.what: a written record or plan of a swiped ad
default.compare_against: the swipe (its transcript, frame map and teardown record) and the stage before
hard_bars: every claim about the swipe is in the swipe — quoted, timed, nothing invented
nothing the swipe does is dropped or changed without a numbered approval

stage1.what: the teardown record: every line, person, place, shot and sound of the swipe
stage1.compare_against: the swipe's transcript and frame map
hard_bars: every spoken line is there verbatim, in the right mouth
every person, place and shot in the swipe is named; nothing is added

stage1b.compare_against: the teardown record and the brand's avatar roster
hard_bars: the avatar named is on the brand's roster
every reason quotes the swipe or the bank

stage1c.what: the doctrine read: framework, awareness, sections
stage1c.compare_against: the teardown record and the marketing doctrine slices
hard_bars: every label is a doctrine id, spelled exactly
every section label matches what that part of the swipe does

stage2.what: the spec: the swipe's reusable structure
hard_bars: every load-bearing element of the swipe is in the spec
nothing in the spec is absent from the swipe

stage3.what: the rewrite: our version of the swipe's script
stage3.compare_against: the teardown record, the spec, the brand's language bank and product files
hard_bars: every place, role, speaker and beat of the swipe is kept (structure lock)
every product fact, price and claim is in the product files
the words are the customer's words from the bank

stage4b.what: the hooks, as fills of the swipe's hook format
stage4b.compare_against: the swipe's opening and the brand's language bank
hard_bars: every fixed word of the swipe's hook is kept
every blank is filled from the bank, never invented

stage4.what: a writing stage of our script (placement, expansion, close, spice)
stage4.compare_against: the stage before, the spec, the offer and the language bank
hard_bars: the swipe's structure is kept
every offer term and price matches the brand's offer bank
spoken lines sound like real talk, nothing a copywriter polished

stage5.what: the brief: every scene, line, person, place, prop and on-screen word
stage5.compare_against: the swipe's frame map and teardown record, the written script, and the locked elements
hard_bars: every swipe shot is carried, in order, with its camera, body geometry and on-screen words
every person is the swipe's person (gender, role) and matches their element
every line is the approved script, word for word

default.compare_against: the locked brief and the locked elements
hard_bars: it matches the brief and the elements; nothing invented

elements.what: the people, looks, voices, places and props a brief needs
elements.compare_against: the brief's words about each, and the swipe frame each recreates
hard_bars: same gender, age and role as the swipe person
every word of the brief about them is true of the element
a place is the same kind of place as the swipe's, empty of people

voices.compare_against: the line in the brief and the speaker's voice element
hard_bars: it says the line, every word, and finishes
it is the speaker's voice (gender, accent)

storyboard.what: the sections, their pictures and clips
storyboard.compare_against: the brief and the swipe's frame map
hard_bars: every scene is in exactly one section
every section copies the swipe shots the brief names

pictures.what: the start picture of each section
pictures.compare_against: the swipe shot it copies, and the locked people, outfits and product
hard_bars: every person is exactly their reference (face, hair, age) — a different-looking person is a BLOCKER
camera position, height, angle, distance, framing, posture, hands and light match the swipe shot
the outfit is the section's look; the product label is the real one
no added words, captions, logos or people

checklist.ask: Framing like the swipe shot: camera position, height, angle, distance, crop, posture
The first instant of the scene as the brief and the swipe have it: who touches what and where, gaze, expression; nothing the scene does later
Each person is exactly ours against their reference: face, hair, age, gender — name anyone who is not
Their skin marks (age spots, freckles) are there, on the right side, as soft as the reference — not missing, not blotchy
Hands and bodies are right: five fingers, no extra limbs; each arm enters from the edge the swipe shot has
Light and shadow match the swipe shot: where the light comes from, how hard or soft, its colour, and the shading and shadows on faces, necks, hands and clothes

Fits the swipe's look and format: a real-footage swipe reads as real phone footage (grain, softness, not posed, not pasted in); an animated or stylised format sits right inside that style. Judged against the swipe, never on its own
Each person wears the section's look as written
Our place for this section, the same kind of place as the swipe's

The product is the real one: label spelled exactly, the packshot's shape and proportions, and its real SIZE against the hand and face — the same size as in the ad's other pictures; props as banked (n/a when absent)
Same nails, jewellery, hair and outfit as this person's other pictures in the ad
No added words, captions, logos (including on screens), extra people or filming gear
Vertical 9:16; people and product inside the middle 4:5 zone
A card or endcard is framed like the swipe's card, nothing holding it, clear space where the words go (n/a for other pictures)

clips.compare_against: its start picture, its voice slice and the swipe's own movement
hard_bars: the person stays their reference from the first frame to the last
the movement is the swipe's movement
lips follow the words; the line finishes

default.what: the cut: timeline, captions, cards, music
default.compare_against: the brief, the swipe's rhythm and the voice timings
hard_bars: every line and card in the brief is in the cut, in order
captions are the words said, spelled right
cuts land where the swipe cuts

default.compare_against: the picture it edits and the one change asked for
hard_bars: only the asked change happened
people stay their reference; the product label stays the real one

default.compare_against: the request, the brand's product photos and the people's references
hard_bars: every person is exactly their reference
the product is the real product
no invented words or claims

default.compare_against: the source, the stage before, the offer bank and the language bank
hard_bars: the source's structure is kept
every price, offer and product fact is in the brand's files
the words are the customer's words; nothing a source does not support

default.compare_against: the slot or brief, the offer bank, the catalogue and the partner roster
hard_bars: every product, price and offer is current and on file
no unfilled notes, no chopped thoughts
the subject and preview match the body

pictures.what: the email's hero and offer pictures
pictures.compare_against: the email's copy and the brand's product photos
hard_bars: the product is the real product
the picture shows what the copy says
no invented words in the picture

default.compare_against: the ad's teardown and the brand's Variable Index
hard_bars: each variation changes only its named variable
every new value is on the Variable Index

default.compare_against: the naming bank, the brand's Meta account file, the offers and the copy
hard_bars: every name follows the naming bank
no expired offer, no held asset
copy and asset belong together

default.compare_against: the holidays, the brand's moments, the offer bank and the element library
hard_bars: every date is right
every offer is on file
every concept fits its moment

default.compare_against: the source and the element library
hard_bars: the source, kind and route are right
every label is in the element library

default.what: an image teardown stage or a draft
default.compare_against: the swipe image and the brand's banks
hard_bars: the swipe's layout and structure are kept
every word comes from the banks
people and product are ours, from references
